items.summary: andrea stella on oscar's prospects next year: "it's been a very complex season for oscar, who's faced challenges with the car, regs, tyres... i now think he's found the right understanding of all these aspects. we want to have an oscar capable of fighting for the title in 2027." https://t.co/dDzhGZs6Ih
items.summary_zh: Andrea Stella 谈 Oscar 明年的前景：“对 Oscar 来说这是一个非常复杂的赛季，他在赛车、规则、轮胎方面都面临挑战……我现在认为他已经对这些方面有了正确的理解。我们希望拥有一个能在 2027 年争夺冠军的 Oscar。”
